TRN-01 · Register a taxpayer
AC-1 Section "1 — Create a taxpayer" shows "[full name] created — mobile [mobile]."
Upon page load: form with fields "Full name", "Mobile (09XXXXXXXXX)", "Email (optional)" and button "Create taxpayer"
Element validations: Full name - text input, required; Mobile (09XXXXXXXXX) - text input, required; Email (optional) - text input, optional
Functional validations: creating a taxpayer displays "[full name] created — mobile [mobile]." in result box
Steps: 1. Navigate to Training setup 2. Fill Full name and Mobile 3. Click "Create taxpayer" 4. Verify result box text

Functional validations: accepts empty email or email matching format rules up to 254 characters
